title: Business insurance: general liability, professional liability, workers comp, cyber
summary: Mandatory in most jurisdictions if you have employees. Comprehensive coverage scaled to your specific risk.
detailsHtml:
The coverage stack

General liability: Third-party bodily injury or property damage. ~$500–$2,000/year for most service businesses, more for higher-risk industries.

Workers compensation: Legally required in nearly every state if you have employees. Premiums vary by industry (clerical: ~0.5% of payroll; construction: 10%+). No-fault coverage for employee injuries on the job.

Professional liability / E&O: Defense and damages for claims of negligent professional work. Essential for consulting, advisory, technology, healthcare, legal businesses.

Cyber liability: Data breach response, ransomware, business interruption from cyber events. Increasingly required by larger customers.

Employment Practices Liability (EPLI): Wrongful termination, discrimination, harassment claims. Once you have 5+ employees, this becomes important.

Directors & Officers (D&O): Once you have a board or outside investors, D&O protects individual board members from personal liability for board decisions.
